title: LIS Relevance
description: Text relevance scoring project for evaluating transcription quality and content relevance
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="Evaluate the relevance and quality of the following text." />
  <Text name="text" value="$text" />
  <Header value="Relevance Score" />
  <Rating name="relevance" toName="text" />
  <Header value="Content Category" />
  <Choices name="category" toName="text" choice="single">
    <Choice value="transactional" />
    <Choice value="informational" />
    <Choice value="conversational" />
    <Choice value="irrelevant" />
  </Choices>
  <Header value="Quality Issues" />
  <Choices name="issues" toName="text" choice="multiple">
    <Choice value="hallucination" />
    <Choice value="truncation" />
    <Choice value="misrecognition" />
    <Choice value="language_switch" />
    <Choice value="none" />
  </Choices>
  <TextArea name="notes" toName="text" rows="2" placeholder="Additional notes..." />
</View>
